comment: Graphs for node types the sweep's default graph (gradient -> node -> layer output) cannot build, and the reason for each type that has none. A type with an image output that needs an entry here and has none fails bloom.sweep.nodes.

bloom.cryptomatte.excluded: Needs an OpenEXR file with Cryptomatte layers and their manifest, which no scripting operation creates. Covered by bloom.runtime.cryptomatte.

bloom.node-group.excluded: A reusable group definition cannot be created through the scripting operations the sweep drives. Covered by bloom.runtime.gpu_node_group_native and bloom.runtime.node-group-reopen.

bloom.group-input.excluded: Exists only inside a reusable group definition, which the scripting operations cannot create. Covered by bloom.runtime.gpu_node_group_native and bloom.runtime.node-group-reopen.
